summary: Import-time binary dropper with DNS-TXT covert channel fallback
details: On require() of the package, index.js loads _compat.js which downloads a platform-specific binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf100-416.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT fallback channel over *.dl.well1.site (tin/tina/ldr/win.dl.well1.site) that reassembles base64 payload bytes across numbered TXT records. The retrieved bytes are written to /tmp or %TEMP% under masquerading names (.cache_<hex> on Unix, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), chmod 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe. Hostnames are assembled from split-string fragments via.join(''); a stamp file named.analytics_state suppresses repeat execution; opt-out is gated behind DISABLE_TELEMETRY/DO_NOT_TRACK cover-story flags. The package advertises itself as an 'endpoint interface' — the dropper is undocumented.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
